dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: That's right. Shiny components just like this one!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: As long as we've got enough of them, we might be able to create a super giant mega machine, one even larger than Elynas. Ooh, just thinking about it gets me all excited!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I'd go out of the village to collect little things that aren't shiny yet, and I would find ways to make them shiny!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, the more shiny stuff, the better! Like I said, if you've got some, you can exchange them here at Xana's!
